name: Cinematic 35mm film register
tagline: Late-1990s Japanese art-cinema look — Kodak Vision3 250D grain, halation, lifted milky blacks, magenta-cyan telecine bias. Beats digital-HD instincts.
description: How to prompt an image model so the output reads as a scanned 35mm film print from circa 1999, not as a modern HD photograph. Covers stock + grade + multi-source isolated lighting + composition (vanishing-point wides, letterbox 1.85:1, small-figure-in-landscape). Use for cinematic-narrative shorts (Iwai-leaning summer pastoral, Tokyo y2k night register, contemplative letterboxed verticals).
